bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12" x 12" x 6" are allowed. Clutches up to 1" x 6" x 4" are also allowed.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12" x 12" x 6"
prohibited: Clear bags larger than 12" x 12" x 6"
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags (with an accompanying child) and medical bags are allowed after a full search. All bags, coats and guests are searched. Prohibited items must go back to your vehicle or be confiscated. Some events have exceptions, so check the event page.

parking.note: Parking is available at the East Garage for pre-paid parking pass holders and the Central Riverfront Garage. Both garages are conveniently located near the venue. No specific pricing information is provided.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Heritage Bank Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Heritage Bank Center offers food and drink options through its partners, including All Access Bar & Grill located on the 5th floor. Nearby, guests can also enjoy specials at Holy Grail and Tin Roof, which are within walking distance.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Heritage Bank Center, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Heritage Bank Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Heritage Bank Center. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Heritage Bank Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
